title: Runbook: Cart Redis Primary Failover Recovery
body: Operational runbook for restoring Cart Service (APP-004) write availability when the backing Redis primary fails over to a replica. Covers Sentinel-driven and forced promotion, degraded-mode write buffering, and pool reconnection to shorten the error window seen in INC-2026-001.

title: Runbook: Promotions Cache Invalidation & Emergency Flush
body: Procedure for invalidating or flushing the Promotions Engine (APP-008) cache when a promotion-window change is not reflected at checkout. Prioritizes targeted per-offer invalidation over full flush and confirms the write-through path from INC-2026-018 remains enabled.

title: Runbook: Payments PSP Failover & Routing
body: Runbook for failing payment authorization over to a secondary payment service provider when the primary PSP degrades (cf. INC-2026-009). Covers circuit-breaker engagement, idempotency-key-safe retries, and preserving the APP-012 PCI cardholder-data boundary.

title: Runbook: ATP Oversell Reconciliation
body: Runbook for detecting and reconciling available-to-promise oversell caused by cross-warehouse reservation races (cf. INC-2026-012). Freezes reservations, reconciles the Inventory (APP-010) ledger against WMS counts, and coordinates cancellation or backorder with Order Management (APP-009).

title: Runbook: Edge Rate-Limit Tuning
body: Runbook for adjusting API Gateway (APP-024) token-bucket rate limits when a too-aggressive threshold rejects legitimate traffic with HTTP 429 (cf. INC-2026-013). Covers per-route limiter inspection, safe widening of rate/burst, and canary rollout per region.

title: Runbook: Edge OIDC Clock-Skew Token Rejection
body: Runbook for diagnosing valid-token rejection at the edge caused by OIDC clock-skew tolerance (cf. INC-2026-014). Covers NTP/time-sync checks on edge pods, widening verification leeway, JWKS freshness, and coordination with the Identity service (APP-014).

title: Runbook: Search Reindex Lag Recovery
body: Runbook for recovering from catalog-to-index propagation lag that surfaces stale prices in Search & Browse (APP-006) results (cf. INC-2026-003). Covers measuring Kafka consumer lag, draining the backlog, and targeted partial reindex of affected SKUs.

title: Runbook: Edge Load-Shedding at Peak
body: Runbook for enabling prioritized load-shedding at the API Gateway (APP-024) when origin saturates under peak load (cf. INC-2026-016). Sheds low-priority and bot traffic first to protect the checkout path and coordinates with Storefront (APP-001) autoscaling.

title: Runbook: Tier-0 Progressive Deploy & Rollback
body: Generic golden-path progressive delivery runbook (canary to percentage rollout to full) with automated rollback on SLO breach, per CANON §7. Includes the mandatory promotions-cache pre-release check introduced after INC-2026-018 and manual rollback procedure.

title: Runbook: Expand-Contract Database Migration
body: Runbook for the backward-compatible expand-contract migration pattern so rollback never requires a schema down-migration under fire (CANON §7.4). Walks the expand, backfill, migrate-reads, and contract phases with per-phase abort criteria and replication-lag monitoring.

title: Runbook: Incident Commander Checklist
body: Process runbook for the Incident Commander role: declaring severity, opening the incident channel, assigning IC/comms/ops/scribe roles, running follow-the-sun handoff for Tier-0 incidents, deciding rollback versus fix-forward, and scheduling the postmortem. Referenced by the Escalation section of every other runbook.

title: Runbook: Checkout p99 Latency Regression
body: Runbook for recovering checkout tail latency when a synchronous Promotions (APP-008) call on the checkout path regresses p99 (cf. INC-2026-019). Covers isolating the hot span in traces and switching the promo call to async/timeout-with-fallback via feature flag.

title: Runbook: Regional Pricing Rule Misconfiguration Rollback
body: Runbook for rolling back a bad regional pricing rule such as the APAC currency-rounding misconfiguration in INC-2026-004. Identifies the offending config version, reverts it in the Pricing service (APP-007), re-resolves prices, and triggers downstream promo-cache invalidation.

title: Runbook: Guest-Checkout Orphaned Loyalty Account Recovery
body: Runbook for containing and cleaning up orphaned Loyalty (APP-015) accounts provisioned by a guest-checkout regression (cf. INC-2026-002, hotfix PR-0312 on CHK-1421). Disables the guest-loyalty provisioning path via flag, identifies orphaned accounts, and quarantines them for reconciliation.

title: Runbook: Catalog Ingestion Stall Recovery
body: Runbook for resuming Product Catalog (APP-005) offer ingestion after a data-platform (APP-020) outage stalls the pipeline (cf. INC-2026-021). Confirms upstream recovery, replays ingestion from the last committed offset, and verifies catch-up without duplicate offers.

title: Runbook: Self-Service Returns Eligibility Regression
body: Runbook for correcting a returns-eligibility rule regression that shows delivered orders as ineligible in My Meridian (APP-021) (cf. INC-2026-015). Rolls back the offending BFF/rule change, clears the eligibility cache, and re-checks against Order Management (APP-009) state.

title: Runbook: Kafka Consumer Lag Recovery
body: Generic runbook for recovering a Kafka consumer group that has fallen behind, applicable to Catalog (APP-005), Search (APP-006), and Order Management (APP-009) consumers. Covers measuring lag, isolating slow or poisoned partitions, dead-letter handling, scaling consumers, and authorized offset resets.

title: Runbook: Emergency Feature-Flag Kill Switch
body: Runbook for safely disabling a bad code path via the platform feature-flag service without a deploy. Covers locating the flag, scoping the change by region/percentage/global, verifying propagation, the break-glass audit trail, and temporary-flag expiry guardrails.

title: Runbook: Canary Auto-Rollback on SLO Breach
body: Runbook for handling automated canary analysis that trips an SLO guardrail (error rate, latency, or saturation) during progressive rollout. Covers confirming the auto-rollback completed, investigating canary metrics, when to override or hold, and re-attempting after a fix.

title: Runbook: Hotfix Cut-and-Deploy
body: Runbook implementing the CANON §7.3 hotfix procedure: cutting a hotfix/<INC-ID>-<slug> branch from the affected release tag, making a minimal targeted change, passing expedited but mandatory smoke and security gates, and forward-merging to main. Uses INC-2026-002's hotfix (PR-0312, CHK-1421) as the worked example.

title: Runbook: PostgreSQL Primary Failover & Connection-Pool Exhaustion
body: Runbook for PostgreSQL primary loss or connection-pool exhaustion affecting PG-backed services such as Pricing (APP-007), Order Management (APP-009), and Payments (APP-012). Covers replica promotion, repointing services, killing idle-in-transaction sessions, tuning PgBouncer, and verifying replication catch-up.

title: Runbook: Payments PCI Incident Containment & Secret Rotation
body: Runbook for containing a suspected credential exposure or PCI-boundary concern in Payments (APP-012). Covers revoking and rotating PSP and service credentials through the platform secret manager, confirming cardholder data never left the APP-012 boundary, and coordinating with Security Engineering.

title: Runbook: Cart Redis Cache Flush & Warm
body: Runbook for clearing corrupted or poisoned entries from the Cart Service (APP-004) Redis cache (for example after a serialization or schema mismatch). Covers targeted pattern deletion, selective shard flush, guarded full flush of ephemeral cart state, and warm-up. Distinct from the failover procedure in RB-0001.

title: Runbook: Inventory Reservation Reconciliation Job
body: Runbook for the reconciliation job that repairs drift between the Inventory (APP-010) reservation ledger, the PostgreSQL source of truth, and WMS (APP-011) counts. Covers dry-run versus apply, interpreting the drift report, releasing stale reservations, and preventing oversell. Complements RB-0004.

title: Runbook: Storefront Origin Saturation & Edge Cache Recovery
body: Runbook for relieving Storefront Web (APP-001) origin saturation under peak by scaling the Node BFF, raising CDN/edge cache hit ratio with extended TTLs and stale-while-revalidate, and shedding non-critical requests (cf. INC-2026-016). Coordinates edge load-shedding with the Core Platform team via RB-0008.
